title: After the Yomiuri Milers C.: Inspiring Courage

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew! All right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Good. My body's moving more and more in sync with my thoughts!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'm able to put more strength in my strides too. Each step is much more powerful than before! Now, if I can just get into this new flow…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'm sure I can run even better!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Nishino Flower returns, she looks like she's figured something out.
choice_data_list: You don't look tired at all.
You don't look tired at all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm not! This must be more proof of my growth!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I'm not enough. This is nowhere near good enough…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr has seemed down ever since the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
choice_data_list: If you're worried, you should go talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Should I? I don't want to be a bother.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What if I say the wrong thing?
choice_data_list: You can't go wrong with kindness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's true… Sometimes, you just need someone to ask.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… Then can you wait for a moment? I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr? Um…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …The wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't reach the wind that will carry me to the one I admire.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, is there someone you look up to, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Is that surprising?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well… A little.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To me, it looks like you're competing more with yourself than anyone else…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is true… but it all started with a single, magnificent gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The awe it inspired in me lifted me up… and it's what has brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But that gale did not offer me unbound freedom.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am faced with a limit—the insurmountable wall of 2,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There is only one thing for me to do—swallow up even the gale that inspired me as I continue to take on this wall.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have resolved myself to run to the endless beyond, until no obstacles stand before me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …But competing with yourself isn't easy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (She's working hard because of the person she looks up to. The person she cares about. Just like me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I remember when I tried to stay positive even when I was having trouble running, but I still felt a wall in front of me. Back then, I…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr? Is it that you want to do your best for that person, but you're afraid of failing?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fear of failure… Yes, perhaps that is the feeling that haunts me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I cannot make my running in the Yasuda Kinen match my ideal, then…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Thank you, Flower. Your kindness has given me much comfort.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I didn't do anything. All I did was listen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You've done more than that. Your running has inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now then, I'll see you at our next race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Zephyr seemed really troubled.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's anything I can do…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But how?
choice_data_list: Well, you're also trying to get over a wall right now, aren't you?
Well, you're also trying to get over a wall right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr is a sprinter and miler specialist trying to tackle medium-distance races. It's a different obstacle to the one before Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Nishino Flower's effort to get used to her new self and elevate her running is plain to see.
choice_data_list: If you can show her how you overcome your hurdle…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe it'll give her some courage!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my absolute very bestest at the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I don't want Zephyr to get crushed by the pressure of trying to run her best for someone else. After all…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trying your best for someone else's sake is such a wonderful, happy thing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely winning the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is the first time Nishino Flower has promised certain victory in a race. I hope her feelings reach Yamanin Zephyr!
